"""A fixture test module whose every read is a constant path."""

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FIXTURE = HERE / "fixtures" / "m"
OPTIONAL = HERE / "fixtures" / "absent.json"
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))

import m  # noqa: E402


class Reads(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reads(self):
        names = sorted(path.name for path in FIXTURE.iterdir())
        if OPTIONAL.exists():
            names.append(OPTIONAL.name)
        self.assertEqual(m.read("x"), {})
        self.assertIn("one.txt", names)

"""A fixture test that hands the repository root to its module."""

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))

import t  # noqa: E402


class Judges(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_judges(self):
        self.assertIn("a.md", t.judge(ROOT))
